sections.changelog:
Added

  • Menu placement: a "MVweb Search" box in Appearance → Menus adds a search item that can be dragged anywhere in a classic menu and is rendered as the live search bar on the front-end.
  • Text-link display mode: alongside "Search bar" and "Icon", the bar can now show as a clickable word (custom label) that expands the field, chosen separately for desktop and mobile.

Changed

  • The old "Show in menu" location setting is replaced by the draggable menu item, which can be placed anywhere in the menu rather than only appended to the end of a location.
